sections.title: Sound of letter C
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (C) /k/. Its main sound is heard in the word (cat) /kæt/, which means a small pet. This letter has three different sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: To make the first sound, lift the back of your tongue to touch the roof of your mouth. Stop the air for a moment, then push it out quickly with no voice. For the second sound, place your tongue tip near your upper teeth. Blow air through the narrow gap with no voice. Put a hand on your throat to feel no vibration.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: This letter makes the sound /k/ before the vowels a, o, u, or before consonants, as in (cup) /kʌp/. It makes the sound /s/ before the letters e, i, or y, as in (city) /sɪ.ti/. In some special words, this letter is not pronounced at all, as in (muscle) /mʌs.əl/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Learners often use voice by mistake when they make the first sound. Keep your vocal cords quiet, so it does not sound like a heavy sound. You might also mix up the two main sounds before the vowels. Check the letter that follows, so you do not pronounce the wrong sound.
